recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. Future wording changes for observation-replaces should be made in HL7/fhir-extensions unless OO explicitly asks for new core Observation guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-38924 was a Published R5 OO issue, resolved Not Persuasive with Modification, asking what status should be assigned to an Observation replaced via the observation-replaces extension. The resolution rejected a fixed base-standard status rule and asked to remove the sentence that the target Observation is now obsolete, replacing it with guidance that implementers must choose the appropriate status because replacement and status are independent and use-case driven.
initial_application: The Jira application comment points to HL7/fhir-extensions commit f67c5f192f04db4b7f1472e597a4efac58b0510f. That commit updated input/definitions/Observation/StructureDefinition-observation-replaces.xml in the Extension Pack to replace the obsolete-language comment with the approved clarification.
additional_context: The current core checkout has no StructureDefinition-observation-replaces source and the old build.fhir.org core extension URL returns 404; the Extension Pack continuous build publishes the extension with the clarification. Core retains only the OID registry entry for the extension. An old source/observation/valueset-observation-relationshiptypes.xml file contains similar RPLC wording, but no current source reference or current/R5 publication URL for that value set was found, so it was treated as legacy/out-of-build rather than as the active extension source. FHIR-54040 is a later R6 Resolved - change required issue about removing core Observation narrative references to observation-replaces; it was not decided in this Applied/Published seed run.
